say:1:1110205001:1.text: "Acquire the ultimate honor, the blood of kin, and receive proof of the setting sun." So this is the legend of the Dusk Lord and the setting sun.

say:2:1110205002:1.text: This is fascinating beyond measure. I wonder what the meaning behind this phrase is.
say:2:1110205002:1.source_cn: 真是有趣，不知道背后代表了什么意义？

say:3:1110205003:1.text: Really? Do outlanders not know about this legend?
say:3:1110205003:1.source_cn: 咦？难道对沙漠外的人来说，这个传说的意义还有什么不明白...
